postgis.spatial_version.description: The minimum version of PostGIS to install or upgrade to. Matches major.minor version.

postgis.enable_outdb_rasters.description: Enable access to rasters stored outside the database filespace.

postgis.gdal_enabled_drivers.description: List of GDAL driver names to explicitly enable for raster processing. If empty, defaults are applied.

postgis.enable_dropdb_at_least.description: If true, allows dropping the PostGIS extension even if the database is not empty. Warning: Data loss risk.
